messages:
Ellen: Sharing a new compact field one-pager draft called 'Harbor'  focused on secure inference, SLA clarity, and deploy-mode decisioning. Need quick copy + routing tags + webinar blurb. Draft link: https://redwood.internal/briefs/harbor (internal).

Ravi: Love the name. Quick ask  pick one headline stat. Field wants a conservative measurable.

June: Suggest hero: "~36% lower inference unit cost; ~30% improved 95th-pct tail latency (typical with Dedicated+cache)." Short and defensible.

Marco: Benchmarks were on Dedicated pools with KV cache + 4-bit quant. I'll attach a tiny table and two PNGs in the brief.

Ellen: SLA line for the one-pager: "Dedicated: 99.9% uptime SLA; Private (VPC/on-prem): contractual SLA options; Hosted: regional redundancy + automated fallback." Keep it punchy.

Ravi: Routing: field asked for intake tags so AEs can filter by deployment mode and urgency. Proposed YAML for ops intake:
```yaml
inbound:
  tags: ["enterprise","Harbor","secure-inference","vpc","onprem","dedicated","SLA","eval-kit","nda-needed","bring-your-workload"]
  assign: sales-eng
  priority: high
  funnel_label: evaluation-request
  intake_note: "include compliance needs, desired latency, and sample workload"
```

June: Add quick-filter tags 'infosec-review' and 'bring-your-model' per field request. Also include 'partner-pilot' if they want a co-dev track.

Ellen: Webinar headline (short): "Harbor: secure inference for regulated production apps" Webinar blurb (long): "Join a 40-minute deep dive: secure serving patterns, benchmark stories, and a guided walkthrough of our evaluation kit. Bring your workload for a tailored ops report. Live Q&A with product + field." Agenda: 1) architecture & SLA options 2) benchmark deep-dive 3) evaluation kit demo + next steps.

Marco: Social post (short): "New brief: Harbor  how teams cut inference cost and meet SLAs for regulated apps. Register for the webinar & request a free evaluation kit: [link + UTM]" Keep it direct.

ops-bot: Webinar slot requested: 2026-08-04 09:00 PT | request 8119.

Ellen: If no objections I'll publish the internal brief tomorrow morning and hand the routing YAML to ops. Final owners: copy (June), benchmarks & PNGs (Marco), routing handoff (Ravi), webinar comms (Ellen). :white_check_mark:
